criteria.requirement: Fix actual cached_property/cached_readonly with __set_name__ and a shared real cache-key policy, so value=cached_property(calculate) caches under value and never shadows calculate. Preserve ordinary decorator behavior, inherited descriptors, class access, independent instances and cached_property manual set/delete while readonly remains protected. Reject the same descriptor bound under different names explicitly, retain legacy function-name fallback for manually unbound descriptors and fail clearly on no-__dict__ objects. Demonstrate evaluation count and method identity, not only metadata.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
